# ImageStow — Free Image Tools, Private by Design

> Free image tools that run 100% in the browser: files are never uploaded, no sign-up. Built by Safwan.Digital. Sister site: PDFStow (PDF tools, same rule).

## Tools
- [JPG to PNG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/jpg-to-png/): Turn a JPG photo into a PNG file.
- [PNG to JPG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/png-to-jpg/): Turn a PNG into a smaller JPG photo.
- [JPG to WebP](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/jpg-to-webp/): Make a JPG about 30% smaller as WebP.
- [PNG to WebP](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/png-to-webp/): Shrink a PNG as a WebP, keeping transparency.
- [WebP to JPG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/webp-to-jpg/): Turn a WebP image into a JPG anyone can open.
- [WebP to PNG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/webp-to-png/): Turn a WebP image into a PNG, keeping transparency.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/heic-to-jpg/): Open iPhone HEIC photos as normal JPGs.
- [SVG to PNG](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/svg-to-png/): Turn an SVG logo or icon into a PNG at any size.
- [Images to PDF](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/images-to-pdf/): Put several images into one PDF file.
- [Compress Image](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/compress-image/): Make an image file smaller, with a quality slider.
- [Compress to a Target Size](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/compress-to-size/): Shrink an image to under 200 KB, 100 KB, 50 KB or your size.
- [Bulk Compress Images](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/bulk-compress/): Compress many images at once and download a ZIP.
- [Resize Image](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/resize-image/): Change an image's width and height in pixels.
- [Resize for Social Media](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/resize-social/): Exact sizes for Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and more.
- [Passport Photo Size](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/passport-photo/): Make a 35 × 45 mm passport-size photo, ready to print.
- [Image Editor](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/image-editor/): Crop, rotate, brighten, add filters and text — all in one.
- [Crop Image](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/crop-image/): Drag a box and cut away the parts you don't want.
- [Rotate & Flip](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/rotate-flip/): Turn an image left or right, or flip it over.
- [Add Watermark](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/add-watermark/): Put your name or shop name across a photo.
- [Blur Part of an Image](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/blur-part/): Hide a face, number plate or address before you share.
- [Add Background / Border](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/add-background/): Put a colour behind a transparent image, or add a border.
- [Remove Photo Metadata](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/remove-metadata/): Strip the hidden camera, date and GPS details from a photo.
- [View Photo Metadata](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/view-metadata/): See what a photo reveals: camera, date and GPS location.
- [Favicon Generator](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/favicon-generator/): Make every website icon size from one image.
- [Colour Picker from Image](https://imagestow.safwan.digital/colour-picker/): Click any spot on a photo to get its colour code.
